[[File:Iris Lake.jpg|thumb|Iris Lake]]

'''Iris Lake''' was located in north-central [[Ashenvale]], east of [[Astranaar]] and west of [[Shael'dryn]]'s [[Moonwell (Ashenvale)|moonwell]]. It was one of the many areas of the [[night elven]] forest which fell to the corruption of [[Felwood]]. The water of the lake was a sickly yellowish green, and twisted [[bog beast]]s roamed the area, attacking anyone who visited seeking one of [[Elune's Tear|Elune's Tear]]s.
